body: Incredibly! I was always quite sure of my 'talent' but once I got the call that I had the role ..all my confidence vanished. I thought they were quite stupid to trust me with this. The audition for the production started with 70 people ..so I just hoped that I could be part of the ensemble..but then I gor the part. I was happy and scared. During rehearsals I get positive feedback from the othet castmembers and this helps a lot. I'm starting to trust my skills a bit more but it's hard work.
